## ♿ Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Used appropriate HTML elements (e.g., `<button>` for actions, `<a>` for navigation).
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Added `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to icon-only buttons or interactive elements without visible text.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Ensured all interactive elements are reachable via `Tab` and have a visible focus state.
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Verified that text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA contrast ratios.
- [ ] **Alt Text**: Provided descriptive `alt` text for informative images; used `alt=""` or `aria-hidden="true"` for decorative ones.
- [ ] **Form Labels**: Every input has an associated `<label>` or appropriate ARIA attribute.
- [ ] **Screen Reader Friendly**: Content order is logical and decorative elements (like emojis) are hidden from screen readers using `aria-hidden="true"`.
